entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I... I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just really disappointed with it and I was hoping I could return it.

I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with the VeloBand. I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... so hard to use. The interface is really confusing and I honestly expected more from it. I've been a VeloFit customer for a long time, and I just feel let down. I even read the user manual cover to cover and it didn't help.
I see. I apologize that the product has been a frustrating experience for you. It's never what we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order and check our policy.
Okay. I really hope you can help. I was counting on that money for some other things this month.

Just one moment... Alright, I have your details here. I can see you received the VeloBand about 12 days ago. Looking at the policy, our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and approve that return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried. You've been incredibly helpful.

You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Just package the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again, David. You've made my day.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
